name: Charlie Parfait
original_name: チャーリー・パルフェ
source:
"Oh, you don't look familiar. Are you a transfer?"

One of the Wordsworth residents known for being rather tough, she is unafraid to give others a piece of her mind. She is quick to react defensively if others are intimidated by her brashness, and she envies [url=/c94030]Mary[/url] for her femininity.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=charlie]official page[/url]]
